scripts.dev: node scripts/guard-uncommitted.js && node scripts/patch-chart-engine.js && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=7780 concurrently "pnpm --filter frontend dev" "pnpm --filter backend dev"
scripts.dev:backend: node scripts/guard-uncommitted.js && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=7780 pnpm --filter backend dev
scripts.dev:frontend: node scripts/guard-uncommitted.js && node scripts/patch-chart-engine.js && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=7780 pnpm --filter frontend dev
scripts.build:frontend: node scripts/patch-chart-engine.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=production NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=7780 pnpm build:i18n && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.build:chart-engine: cd frontend/components/(ext)/chart-engine && npm install && npm run build
scripts.start: node scripts/guard-uncommitted.js --warn && node scripts/maintenance-off.js && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=7780 pm2 start production.config.js --env production
scripts.start:thread: node scripts/guard-uncommitted.js --warn && node scripts/maintenance-off.js && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=7780 pm2 start production.thread.config.js --env production
scripts.start:backend: node scripts/guard-uncommitted.js --warn && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=7780 pm2 start production.backend.config.js --env production
scripts.stop:all: pm2 stop all 2>/dev/null || echo 'No PM2 processes to stop'
scripts.maintenance:stop: pm2 stop maintenance && pm2 delete maintenance
scripts.updator: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=7780 pnpm stop && pnpm update-packages-quick && pnpm start:backend && node -e "console.log('⏳ Waiting 180 seconds before seeding...'); setTimeout(() => { console.log('✅ Wait complete, proceeding with seed...'); process.exit(0); }, 180000)" && pnpm stop && pnpm seed && pnpm build:frontend && pnpm start
scripts.update-packages-quick: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=7780 pnpm --filter backend update && pnpm --filter frontend update && pnpm update
scripts.i18n: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=7780 cd tools/translation-manager && npm start
scripts.fix:eco-orders: cd backend && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=7780 node scripts/fix-ecosystem-orders.mjs
scripts.fix:eco-candles: cd backend && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=7780 node scripts/fix-ecosystem-candles.mjs
scripts.bundle: pnpm extract:permission && pnpm build:chart-engine && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('backend/dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && pnpm build:backend && pnpm ob
